title: Activation governance ticker & ownership ledger
body:
Purpose: a lightweight, operational-first governance ticker designed to run alongside a product activation (beta->general) so decision-makers can see signal, owners, and pre-defined commitments on a single scrollable canvas. Intended audience: product-ops, oncall leads, SRE, launch commander, and cross-functional owners.

High-level design principles:
- Minimal friction: 6–10 KPIs surfaced, each mapped to a single owner + 1 backup, with explicit escalation route.
- Time-boxed commitments: micro-commitments (2–8 hour actions) tied to thresholds so triage is fast.
- Signal tiers: green/yellow/red with automated paging rules and human confirmation for escalation.
- Run-as-doc: this doc is a live source-of-truth during activation windows; link from mission-control dashboard.

Governance cadence (recommended):
- Prelaunch week: daily 30-min sync (product-ops + owners) to validate ticker configuration and runbook attachments.
- Launch day: 6:00–18:00 command pad with 1-hour heartbeat standups; after hours oncall rotation with 3x check-ins (start/mid/end).
- Postlaunch (first 7 days): twice-daily 30-min pulse + daily retrospective at end of day 7.

Ticker fields (single-line per KPI):
- KPI name | primary owner | backup owner | target (green/yellow/red) | cadence | last value | trend | last action note

Ownership ledger (copyable row format):
- Owner name | role | slack handle | pager (oncall team) | escalation contact | commit window (hrs)
- Example: Rosa Alvarez | Product-ops Lead | @rosa | eng-oncall | Julian Kim (SRE), CX: Priya N. | 2h

Micro-commitments (examples mapped to signals):
- Token-cost spike (>20% above baseline 30m avg): Owner: Ethan Moore (pricing) commit: throttle noncritical routes within 15m, confirm rollback plan within 30m.
- Latency p95 > 800ms sustained 5m: Owner: Julian Kim (SRE) commit: enable short-term autoscale, shift traffic to dedicated pool; notify product-ops in 10m.
- Quality regression (golden prompt BLEU drop > 6%): Owner: ML Evals team (Rosa) commit: flip model variant to previous pinned, run smoke evals, notify stakeholders.

Sample KPI pulse lines (for ticker population):
- Request rate (rps): target green < 1k rps, yellow 1k-2.5k, red > 2.5k | owner: eng-traffic | cadence: 1m | last: 1,140 | trend: ↗ 12% | note: monitoring surge from experiment group B
- Token cost / 1k requests: green < $0.65, yellow $0.65-$0.90, red > $0.90 | owner: finance-product | cadence: 15m | last: $0.72 | trend: ↗ | note: heavy long-context queries from onboarding flow
- P50 generation latency: green <120ms, yellow 120-300ms, red >300ms | owner: serving-runtime | cadence: 1m | last: 95ms | trend: stable | note: kv-cache hit 84%
- P95 generation latency: green <400ms, yellow 400-800ms, red >800ms | owner: serving-runtime | cadence: 1m | last: 412ms | trend: ↗ | note: tail latency spike aligned with batch window
- Error rate (5xx): green <0.2%, yellow 0.2-1%, red >1% | owner: sre | cadence: 1m | last: 0.37% | trend: ↗ | note: partial degradation in region eu-west-2
- New user conversion (activation funnel): green > 15%, yellow 8-15%, red <8% | owner: growth | cadence: 60m | last: 11.3% | trend: ↘ | note: signup-to-run drop after onboarding modal change
- Golden-prompt pass rate (quality gate): green >92%, yellow 85-92%, red <85% | owner: ml-evals | cadence: 30m | last: 89% | trend: ↘ | note: variant C underperforming on summarization tasks

Escalation matrix (short):
- Tier 1 (owners): respond within commit window, update ticker with action and ETA.
- Tier 2 (oncall leads): if Tier 1 misses window or signal escalates to red; take tactical actions (traffic shift, model flip).
- Tier 3 (launch commander + exec oncall): if customer-impacting outage or sustained red >30m; declare incident and follow incident runbook.

Decision heuristics (examples to include in runbook attachments):
- Rollback a model variant if golden-prompt pass <85% for 3 consecutive cadence checks and customer complaints >5 in 60m.
- Throttle expensive routes if token cost / 1k requests > red threshold for 2 consecutive 15m checks and revenue impact < projected incremental retention.

Runbook attachments (linked per KPI row): ensure each KPI links to a small runbook snippet: quick triage checklist, rollback command, contact snippet, and a short smoke test shell. Keep runbooks <1 page and replace links as part of postmortem.

Postlaunch ledger entries (how to snapshot):
- At each end-of-shift heartbeat, owners write a one-line ledger update appended to ticker: time | name | action | outcome | follow-up owner. This helps handoffs and retro.

Quick start checklist (prelaunch copyable):
1) Populate ticker with 6 canonical KPIs + 2 experiment KPIs.
2) Confirm owners + backups and validate pager/contact info.
3) Attach runbooks (<=1 page) to each KPI.
4) Run a rehearsal: simulate a yellow signal for each KPI and run through micro-commitments.
5) Finalize command pad schedule and channel routing.

Notes and open questions (to resolve in prelaunch dry run):
- Should we automate tiered paging for cost signals or keep human-in-the-loop for first yellow?
- Who owns cross-customer comms for quality regressions (product marketing vs. customer-success)?
- Define exact retention window for sample logs used to validate golden-prompt metrics.

Appendix: quick templates (paste into ticker rows)
- KPI row template: "{{KPI}} | {{owner}} | {{backup}} | {{green}}/{{yellow}}/{{red}} | {{cadence}} | {{last}} | {{trend}} | {{note}}"
- Ownership ledger template: "{{name}} | {{role}} | {{slack}} | {{pager}} | {{escalation}} | {{commit_window}}h"

End of doc. Use this as the live, editable ticker during activation windows. Keep updates terse and time-stamped.
